text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers preserve the original lexing logic, including the `is '/' or '*'` pattern precedence, the prefix loop, the verbatim, escape and newline handling, and the `Math.Min` clamp. By my count `Lex` and each helper (`StringEnd` is the highest at about 14) fall under 15. I did not build the project or run the tests, so the build condition rests on a read of the code, which shows no obvious unused variables or accessibility problems.
